items.title: Target (TGT) Stock Fair Value Rises After Q2 Spurs Higher Analyst Targets
items.summary: Target is back in focus after analysts raised their fair value estimate from about US$133.84 to roughly US$162.76, a move that aligns with a wave of higher price targets across Wall Street. This shift follows Q2 research that has become more constructive, with firms debating how much of Target's merchandising and traffic recovery is already reflected in the stock. items.title: Can Kroger Keep Its Earnings Promise With Sales This Weak?
items.summary: Kroger (KR) has cut its 2026 same-store sales outlook and kept its 2026 profit outlook. If you own the stock, the easy comfort is that earnings held. The risk sits inside that comfort. The cost savings holding up profit are the same savings management plans to spend on lower shelf prices, and the stock is down 15% over the past six months.
